job.rawJd:
Summary

The CX Lead will execute the regional digital customer experience strategy and drive optimization and continuous improvement across digital customer journeys. This role partners with Digital, Marketing, Sales, UX, Analytics, and business teams to deliver seamless, customer-centric, data-informed experiences across web, eCommerce, and digital tools.

Responsibilities

Execute digital customer experience strategy and roadmap.
Lead CX initiatives across B2B and eCommerce digital channels.
Apply customer journey thinking, UX principles, content storytelling, and behavioral analytics.
Identify friction points and opportunities to improve engagement, usability, and conversion.
Support CRO, personalization, and optimization of digital tools and eCommerce experiences.
Own planning, coordination, and delivery of CX projects.
Manage multiple workstreams, timelines, documentation, risks, and dependencies.
Collaborate with UX, content, Marketing, Product, Analytics, and Digital teams.
Track performance, KPIs, and provide actionable insights to leadership.

Qualifications

5-7 years of experience in customer experience, UX, digital marketing, digital operations, CRM, or related roles.
Experience leading CX or digital initiatives from concept through execution.
Experience with customer research, journey mapping, and analytics.
Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Working knowledge of digital platforms, MarTech, CMS, CRM, testing, and analytics tools.
Data-informed mindset with strong communication skills.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.

paragraphs: I am applying for the CX Lead role with Confidential Employer. My background combines enterprise customer experience, product strategy, research, analytics, and digital delivery. For more than six years, I have led UX and experience work across a large B2B product suite, backed by eight years managing digital campaigns, consumer web programs, CRM work, and cross-functional client delivery.

At Kinesso, I led research and UX strategy for more than 20 products used by 7,000+ people across 22 white-label brands. I built the company's first UX research practice with interviews, prototype testing, beta groups, behavioral analytics, and shared documentation. Findings and adoption data became roadmap priorities for navigation, dashboards, personalization, brand theming, and product support. I also helped turn channel scoring, benchmarks, and recommendations into a repeatable digital experience audit with client-ready outputs.

Earlier agency roles gave me another side of the customer journey. I worked across consumer websites, digital campaigns, loyalty, CRM patient support, online communities, and integrated brand programs. That work required clear briefs, timelines, production coordination, status reporting, and close partnership across strategy, content, UX, creative, development, and client teams.

The clearest gap is direct ownership of an eCommerce storefront and a formal CRO program. I would not present my background as if I already owned a checkout funnel or a named experimentation stack. What I do bring is the operating discipline around it: research the journey, find the friction, connect behavior and performance data to priorities, coordinate the work, and keep the customer need visible through delivery.
I would welcome a conversation about how that mix of enterprise CX, digital strategy, and delivery leadership could support the team's regional customer experience roadmap.

resume.summary: Customer experience and product strategy lead with 15 years across enterprise UX, digital products, research, analytics, marketing, and client delivery. My work is grounded in enterprise CX and digital journey leadership across 20+ B2B products used by 7,000+ people, where customer research, behavioral analytics, and adoption data shaped roadmap priorities for navigation, personalization, dashboards, and product support. Earlier agency work adds consumer web, CRM, digital campaigns, budgets, timelines, and cross-functional delivery.
